6939-old-mortality-volume-1.title: Old Mortality Volume 1
6939-old-mortality-volume-1.creator: Sir Walter Scott
6939-old-mortality-volume-1.description: A book by Sir Walter Scott. The account of the pilgrim, as given by Sir Walter from Mr. Train's memoranda, needs no addition. About Old Mortality's son, John, who went to America in 1776 (? 1774), and settled in Baltimore, a curious romantic myth has gathered. Train told Scott more, as his manuscript at Abbotsford shows, than Scott printed. Train, John Paterson, of Baltimore, had a son Robert and a daughter Elizabeth.

arxiv-2201-05000.title: Automated Reinforcement Learning: An Overview
arxiv-2201-05000.creator: Reza Refaei Afshar, Yingqian Zhang, Joaquin Vanschoren, Uzay Kaymak
arxiv-2201-05000.description: Abstract Reinforcement Learning and recently Deep Reinforcement Learning are popular methods for solving sequential decision making problems modeled as Markov Decision Processes. RL modeling of a problem and selecting algorithms and hyper-parameters require careful considerations as different configurations may entail completely different performances.

arxiv-2210-16903.title: On Gelfand and MacPherson’s combinatorial formula for Pontrjagin classes
arxiv-2210-16903.creator: Olakunle Abawonse, Laura Anderson
arxiv-2210-16903.description: Abstract . In [ GM92 ] Gelfand and MacPherson gave a local and combinatorial formula for the Pontrjagin classes of a differential manifold. We give an expanded version of their discussion and highlight the origins of combinatorial differential manifolds in their work. 1.

arxiv-2212-07864.title: Neural-network-based level-1 trigger upgrade for the SuperCDMS experiment at SNOLAB
arxiv-2212-07864.creator: J. S. Wilson
arxiv-2212-07864.description: Abstract The extended physics program of the SuperCDMS SNOLAB dark matter search experiment aims to maximize the sensitivity to low-mass dark matter. To realize this, an upgrade of the existing level-1 trigger of the data acquisition system is proposed by making use of a recurrent neural network to be implemented on the trigger FPGA.

arxiv-2304-08450.title: Quantum logic and meaning
arxiv-2304-08450.creator: Sebastian Horvat, and, Iulian D. Toader
arxiv-2304-08450.description: Abstract This paper gives a formulation of quantum logic in the abstract algebraic setting laid out by Dunn and Hardegree (2001). On this basis, it provides a comparative analysis of viable quantum logical bivalent semantics and their classical counterparts, thereby showing that the truth-functional status of classical and quantum connectives is not as different as usually thought.

arxiv-2307-12973.title: Wisdom of Instruction-Tuned Language Model Crowds. Exploring Model Label Variation
arxiv-2307-12973.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit remarkable text classification capabilities, excelling in zero- and few-shot learning (ZSL and FSL) scenarios. However, since they are trained on different datasets, performance varies widely across tasks between those models. Recent studies emphasize the importance of considering human label variation in data annotation.

arxiv-2308-15782.title: On Card guessing games: limit law for no feedback one-time riffle shuffle
arxiv-2308-15782.creator: Markus Kuba, Alois Panholzer
arxiv-2308-15782.description: Abstract . We consider the following card guessing game with no feedback. An ordered deck of n n cards labeled 1 1 up to n n is riffle-shuffled exactly one time. Then, the goal of the game is to maximize the number of correct guesses of the cards.

arxiv-2406-06651.title: Short-Term Electricity Demand Forecasting of Dhaka City Using CNN with Stacked BiLSTM
arxiv-2406-06651.creator: Kazi Fuad Bin Akhter 1 , Sadia Mobasshira 2 , Saief Nowaz Haque 3 , Mahjub Alam Khan Hesham 4 , Tanvir Ahmed 5
arxiv-2406-06651.description: Abstract The precise forecasting of electricity demand also referred to as load forecasting, is essential for both planning and managing a power system. It is crucial for many tasks, including choosing which power units to commit to, making plans for future power generation capacity, enhancing the power network, and controlling electricity consumption.

arxiv-2410-02553.title: Jordan left α \alpha -centralizer on certain algebras
arxiv-2410-02553.creator: M. Eisaei, M. J. Mehdipour , Gh. R. Moghimi
arxiv-2410-02553.description: Abstract In this paper, we investigate Jordan left α \alpha -centralizer on algebras. We show that every Jordan left α \alpha -centralizer on an algebra with a right identity is a left α \alpha -centralizer. We also investigate this result for Banach algebras with a bounded approximate identity.

arxiv-2410-21565.title: Dual Quadrature Phasemeter for Space-Based Interferometry
arxiv-2410-21565.creator: Callum S. Sambridge, Kirk McKenzie
arxiv-2410-21565.description: Abstract This letter presents a dual quadrature phasemeter, an implementation of a phase-locked loop designed to track the phase of homodyne and heterodyne inter-satellite laser links. The dual quadrature phasemeters use dual quadrature optical detection to enable an alternate phase readout scheme that operates with wider bandwidths and on signals with carrier frequency differences down to DC.

arxiv-2507-23395.title: Popov Mirror-Prox Method for Variational Inequalities Thanks: This work was funded by the National Science Foundation awards CCF-2106336 and CIF-2134256. Thanks: Some of the preliminary results have appeared in chakraborty2024popov (accepted in IEEE CDC 2024) for deterministic settings but under mor
arxiv-2507-23395.creator: Abhishek Chakraborty, Angelia Nedić
arxiv-2507-23395.description: Abstract This paper establishes the convergence properties of the Popov mirror-prox algorithm for solving stochastic and deterministic variational inequalities (VIs) under a polynomial growth condition on the mapping variation. Unlike existing methods that require prior knowledge of problem-specific parameters, we propose step-size schemes that are entirely parameter-free in both constant and diminishing forms.

arxiv-2511-18095.title: Quantum and classical analyses of intertwined phase transitions in odd-mass Nb isotopes
arxiv-2511-18095.creator: \firstname A. \lastname Leviatan \fnsep
arxiv-2511-18095.description: Abstract Quantum phase transitions (QPTs) in odd-mass Nb isotopes are investigated in the framework of the interacting boson-fermion model with configuration mixing. A quantum analysis reveals a Type I QPT (gradual shape-evolution within the intruder configuration) superimposed on a Type II QPT (abrupt crossing of normal and intruder states), thus demonstrating the occurrence of intertwined QPTs.

pmc-10569356.title: Influencing ionic conductivity and mechanical properties of ionic liquid polymer electrolytes by designing the chemical monomer structure
pmc-10569356.creator: Lisa Ehrlich, Doris Pospiech, Petra Uhlmann, Felix Tzschöckell, Martin D. Hager, Brigitte Voit
pmc-10569356.description: Polymeric single chloride-ion conductor networks based on acrylic imidazolium chloride ionic liquid monomers AACXImCYCl as reported previously are prepared. The chemical structure of the polymers is varied with respect to the acrylic substituents (alkyl spacer and alkyl substituent in the imidazolium ring).

pmc-11432291.title: Anterior Segment Optical Coherence Tomography for the Tailored Treatment of Mooren’s Ulcer: A Case Report
pmc-11432291.creator: Luca Lucchino, Elvia Mastrogiuseppe, Francesca Giovannetti, Alice Bruscolini, Marco Marenco, Alessandro Lambiase, Jose Ignacio Fernandez-Vigo
pmc-11432291.description: Background: Mooren’s ulcer (MU) is a rare and debilitating form of peripheral ulcerative keratitis (PUK), characterized by a crescent-shaped ulcer with a distinctive overhanging edge at the corneal periphery. If left untreated, MU can lead to severe complications such as corneal perforation and blindness.

pmc-11675146.title: 5-Hydroxytryptamine G-Protein-Coupled Receptor Family Genes: Key Players in Cancer Prognosis, Immune Regulation, and Therapeutic Response
pmc-11675146.creator: Simeng Liu, Mingang He, Hefen Sun, Yi Wu, Wei Jin
pmc-11675146.description: Background: Firstly, 5-hydroxytryptamine G-protein-coupled receptors (HTGPCRs) are a family of 13 genes associated with cancer progression. Nevertheless, a comprehensive understanding of HTGPCRs in cancer remains largely lacking. Method: We tested the gene expression levels and prognostic values for the HTGPCRs in relation to pan-cancer.

pmc-12485489.title: Categorizing prediction modes within low-pLDDT regions of AlphaFold2 structures: near-predictive, pseudostructure and barbed wire
pmc-12485489.creator: Christopher J. Williams, Vincent B. Chen, David C. Richardson, Jane S. Richardson
pmc-12485489.description: Behavioral modes of AlphaFold2 predictions at low pLDDT are identified and described, ranging from unprotein-like ‘barbed wire’ to near-predictive folds, and a tool to automate this identification is provided. Associations between prediction modes and features of interest, such as regions of conditional folding and signal peptides, are discussed. Introduction AlphaFold structure prediction (Jumper et al.

pmc-12663407.title: Structural functionalization of TEMPO modified Ni-MOF for electrocatalytic applications
pmc-12663407.creator: Wenmin Zhang, Yufei Wang, Lan Wang, Yuling Li, Haoran Sun, Congjun Liu, Yong Wang, Dongxi Zhang, Jiaxiang Zhang
pmc-12663407.description: Despite their promise, the low conductivity of Metal–Organic Frameworks (MOFs) impedes their effectiveness as electrocatalysts. To address this limitation and boost electron transport and structural stability, functionalization techniques can be applied. This work specifically details the enhancement of Ni-MOF’s electronic structure and activity via TEMPO modification, evaluating its efficacy for alcohol oxidation reactions.

pmc-13342062.creator: Vishanna Balbirsingh, Shaima A. Hashem, Michalis Georgiou, Siying Lin, Gavin Arno, Mariya Moosajee, Andrew R. Webster, Michel Michaelides, Omar A. Mahroo

pmc-13475663.title: A blended phenotype of primary immunodeficiency and Temtamy syndrome: Dual homozygosity for STK4 and C12orf57 gene variants in a Tunisian infant
pmc-13475663.creator: M. Hsairi, A. Kammoun, H. Fendri, M. Guirat, H. Kammoun, Z. Mnif, L. Gargouri
pmc-13475663.description: We report a 6-month-old male, born to consanguineous parents, presented with recurrent bronchopneumonia, global developmental delay, and craniofacial dysmorphism. Initial workup revealed profound T-cell lymphopenia and hypoplasia of the splenium of the corpus callosum. Whole exome sequencing (WES) identified two homozygous pathogenic variants: a mutation in C12orf57, diagnostic of Temtamy syndrome, and a mutation in STK4, confirming a primary immunodeficiency.

pmc-13682014.title: Neoadjuvant versus adjuvant chemotherapy in luminal B-like breast cancer: a subset analysis of the CANTO study
pmc-13682014.creator: T. Gaillard, P. Cottu, O. Tredan, A.-L. Martin, C. Gaudin, A. Bertaut, C. Cheymol, C. Kaderbhai, F. Cherifi, M. Campone, M.-A. Mouret-Reynier, A. Di-Meglio, F. Reyal, A.S. Hamy-Petit, E. Laas
pmc-13682014.description: BackgroundThe benefit of neoadjuvant chemotherapy (NAC) in hormone receptor (HR)-positive/human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2)-negative breast cancer (BC) remains uncertain, given low pathologically documented complete response (pCR) rates and limited long-term comparative data. We compared overall survival (OS) between NAC and adjuvant chemotherapy (AC) in luminal B-like breast cancer treated in routine practice.
